title: Deliver application clipboard writes to the attached viewer
observable_contract: Application-owned OSC 52 clipboard writes reach the interacting terminal and its configured desktop helper. Plain and write-only tmux-wrapped requests share the same policy checks; clipboard reads and general passthrough remain disabled. A desktop viewer attaching to a remotely started session supplies the display environment, and a phone with no display variables does not clear that access.
manual_limits: Real XFCE tests run under a private Xvfb/D-Bus display. VM clipboard permissions and physical phone clipboard behavior remain separate deployment checks.
result_policy: Test reports describe a particular artifact and run; no historical pass is asserted here.
